# Grok App

> Grok App is an unofficial open-source desktop workbench for the local Grok Build CLI.

Grok App is not an official xAI product. It is a community MIT-licensed desktop app that turns the local Grok Build CLI into a multi-project, multi-session workbench with permissions and media preview.

## Canonical URLs

- Site: https://grok-app.com/
- Source: https://github.com/RongleCat/grok-app
- Website source: https://github.com/RongleCat/grok-app-website
- Downloads: https://github.com/RongleCat/grok-app/releases
- Open source page: https://grok-app.com/opensource/
- FAQ: https://grok-app.com/faq/

## Facts

- License: MIT
- Platforms: macOS (Apple Silicon / Intel), Windows 10/11 (64-bit), Linux (AppImage / DEB / RPM)
- Installers live on GitHub Releases only. This website does not host or proxy installer binaries.
- Author / contact: 铁柱AGI — https://x.com/cgnot996

## Key features

- Multi-project workbench with isolated context, files, and sessions
- Parallel sessions for concurrent work
- Fine-grained permission modes (allow / ask / deny)
- In-session file and media preview
- Skins and appearance controls
- Automations via plans and triggers
- Local-first: talks to Grok Build on your machine

## What it is not

- Not an official xAI product
- Not a hosted web chat
- Not a substitute for installing the local Grok Build CLI
